rule: A candidate is a pull request of a development repository group of the AACR split, from one of the group's AACR repositories under the name GitHub now answers with, merged into the default branch between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-31, that: is not authored by a bot; changes as many lines (additions plus deletions) as AACR's usable cases, from the fewest to the most; has a review by someone other than its author and no review that requested changes; and within 90 days of its merge, read after those days had passed, has no later commit naming it that reads as a fix, revert or follow-up, no later issue or pull request linking it that is labelled or titled as a bug, fix or revert (its own commits, and lines that only quote its title such as backports and release notes, aside), no file of it renamed, and no later commit on the default branch that reads as a fix, revert or follow-up and changes, or inserts next to, a line it added or a place it removed lines. Its lines are placed in that commit's parent by a diff of the file at its head and at that parent; a line that cannot be placed counts as touched. Each group's merged pull requests (GitHub's search, the 100 opened last) are taken in the order of sha256(salt, NUL, group, NUL, repository#number) until 2 are listed or 12 checked. A candidate is not a case: it enters suites/clean/cases.json only through a person's clean ruling (queue.mjs decide) and clean.mjs admit.
